findings.text: follow-on: the landing line reports 479 new files (139 plan, 342 run; 4,889,411 bytes) but those are the whole 481-file tree: two run records pre-existed at the base, so the additions are 139 plan and 340 run totalling 4,872,174 bytes, an overstatement of 2 files and 17,237 bytes
follow-on: the commit subject reads import nova host plan reviews while the commit also adds 340 run-review records, so the subject names a narrower change than the commit carries

item_verdicts.diff: 479 added files (139 plan, 340 run) under docs/state/nova/reviews, no modifications and no deletions, all parsing as valid JSON.
item_verdicts.done_when: the named points hold on re-run — 430 records and 49 delivered reports imported, 2 already present, 0 refused, 0 quarantined, 0 deleted, and a second dry run reports 0 delivered reports without a record and 0 refused.
item_verdicts.goal: the change does what the brief names, committing the records the staging store left behind into the project's committed review tree.
item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest records the census counts, the write counts, the commit sha and the log paths; its landing line's file and byte figures describe the tree rather than the additions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: only docs/state/nova/reviews is committed, matching the node's declared path, by explicit git add.

justifications.durability: the work is committed with a conventional subject and a body on the run's worktree branch, the worktree is clean, and a second import pass is idempotent.
justifications.evidence: every count in the census and write logs is checkable and agrees with the tree, but the manifest's landing line labels the whole 481-file tree as the 479 additions, overstating both the file split and the byte total.
justifications.fit: the node used the provided import_host_reviews.py rather than a bespoke path, honouring the one-commit-per-project shape of the plan node.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node committed nova's host staging reviews into docs/state/nova/reviews exactly as the import node requires, 430 recognised records and 49 delivered reports, with nothing deleted or quarantined.
justifications.reuse: the import is delegated to the existing script and the shared committed-review writer, so no second mechanism for staging a record was introduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: the commit adds only 479 files under docs/state/nova/reviews, all additions and no deletions, and the only other writes are the fenced report sidecars the import script clears.
